B is better. Both correctly identify the main bug: the `WHERE p.status = 'succeeded'` filter turns the LEFT JOIN into an inner join, so zero-payment customers disappear. B then covers more business-relevant problems for this use case: annual and quarterly plans generating false alarms, churned or brand-new accounts being included, and refunds counting as successful payments. A's points about UTC and date formatting matter less here, and its item 4 is mostly filler. B also stays closer to the 200-word limit, while A's length is borderline.

B
